page.layout: One page, blank paper. Top left: a pasted bookseller's label, text only. Centre: an engraved bookplate with a coat of arms and a name line beneath it. No other text on the page.

main_text.l: J. L. C. JACOB, libraire à La Haye,
qui se charge des commissions pour tout ce qui a
rapport aux ventes et livres anciens.

page.notes: The top-left label is a pasted bookseller's slip (J. L. C. Jacob, bookseller at The Hague), not part of the book's own printing. The centre is an engraved ex-libris: a lion crest above a shield with a tower, flanked by foliage, with a motto scroll under the shield. The scroll letters are too small to read, so they are marked illegible. The name line is the only legible text of the plate. Show-through and paper stains are not transcribed.
